name: SIMKL / MyAnimeList
author: Lichtspiel
description: Marks what someone finished as watched on SIMKL and MyAnimeList. Each person connects their own accounts under Settings → Account. SIMKL: create an app at https://simkl.com/settings/developer/ (redirect URI urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob) and enter its Client ID (simkl_client_id). MyAnimeList: create an app at https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig (type "other", any redirect URL, e.g. this server's address) and enter its Client ID and the same redirect URL (mal_client_id, mal_redirect_url; mal_client_secret only if MyAnimeList shows one). MyAnimeList gets anime only: titles with a MyAnimeList id, which the Anime details plugin adds.
